row_4_modularity.description: Broke down monolithic MainGraphState into 11 focused state objects (ResumeContext, JobContext, etc.)
row_4_modularity.benefit: Easier to test, maintain, and understand

row_4_modularity.description: Removed global singletons (COST_TRACKER, HIL_MANAGER, TOOL_REGISTRY) in favor of WorkflowContext
All agents receive WorkflowContext via constructor, access dependencies via context
row_4_modularity.benefit: Decoupled components, easier to unit test

row_5_caching.description: Redis-based CacheManager with SHA256 cache keys (provider+model+prompt+temp)
row_5_caching.benefit: Major cost reduction for repeated prompts

row_5_caching.description: All jobs in batch share same CacheManager instance
row_5_caching.benefit: Cross-job cache hits for similar prompts

row_5_caching.description: CacheManager tracks hits/misses, provides hit rate statistics

row_6_performance.description: All model clients (Anthropic, Gemini) use async/await with AsyncBaseModelClient
AsyncBulletCritiqueAgent uses asyncio.gather to critique all bullets in parallel
row_6_performance.benefit: N bullets critiqued in time of 1 (vs sequential)

row_6_performance.description: run_batch uses asyncio with semaphore-based concurrency control
row_6_performance.benefit: Process multiple jobs concurrently (controlled by max_concurrent_llm_calls)

row_6_performance.description: All meta-learning agents use async execution

preserved_from_v9_9.description: Local PII detection (Presidio) and bias detection (regex) preserved
Specific exception types (ModelAPIError, JSONParsingError, FileIOError) preserved

performance_gains.bullet_critique: Up to 5x faster (5 bullets critiqued in parallel vs sequential)
performance_gains.cost_reduction: 30-70% via LLM caching (depends on prompt repetition)

breaking_changes: Agents now require WorkflowContext instead of blackboard dict
State is now MainGraphState dataclass instead of TypedDict
migration_impact.migration_effort: HIGH - requires code changes in custom agents
migration_impact.backwards_compatibility: NONE - v10.0 is a breaking refactor
